example_selection: Both native constituent answers correct; composed native incorrect; composed final correct; ambiguous graph candidates.

captions.figure1: A contextual composition failure and the functional operations studied. Left: exact supporting sentences and native responses from one frozen CoRe-2Wiki test source. Each constituent question is answered correctly under the same ten-paragraph evidence, while the composed question fails. Right: bridge-address recovery, paragraph-access allocation, and relation-conditioned content reading are distinct operations tested by the study. Their arrangement does not assert three exclusive consecutive layer ranges.
captions.figure2: Causal diagnosis of contextual composition. (a) Shared-context direct-target/composed queries reveal question-sensitive paragraph access; head counts are selected on discovery data, with selected versus layer-matched random knockout on test sources. (b) A factorial intervention independently changes paragraph mass and the within-paragraph conditional attention donated by a direct-target query, leaving receiver values and output projections unchanged. (c) Reciprocal object-surface exchange tests whether answers follow local evidence while preserving global word and character counts. The shared-context factorization and content interventions use the frozen discovery quadruplets. All colored head grids and bars are schematics, not measured effect sizes.
captions.figure3: Mechanism-derived repair. (a) Answer-only tuning updates selected heads; native projection slices are restored only at fixed model-specific prefill positions, while cached decoding retains trained weights. The token mask is illustrative; exact per-model scopes are listed. (b) An input title graph supplies candidate paragraphs, a reader fitted on training-only paragraph features selects the bridge when candidates are ambiguous, and the original root and chosen bridge text are passed to the same scoped model. The feature matrix is schematic: the full reader uses the mean-question and last-question paragraph attention from each of H selected heads, plus log paragraph token fraction and title mention (2H+2 features). The shown graph and composed answer are from a completed formal test example. No support annotations or answer labels are used at deployment.
